description: Run and debug Android native projects from VSCode with Flutter-like device selection
config.sdkPath.description: Path to Android SDK. If empty, uses ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT environment variable.
config.javaHome.description: Path to JDK. If empty, auto-detects from JAVA_HOME, Android Studio, or common install locations.
config.appModule.description: App module name (e.g., app, mobile, wear). Default: app.
config.buildVariant.description: Build variant to use (e.g., debug, release).
config.autoSelectDevice.description: Automatically select a device when one connects.
